project.name: treehouse-sqlalchemy
project.summary: A terminal books catalog imports suggested titles into SQLite, adds or lists books, edits/deletes a selected ID and reports catalog statistics. No HTTP routes.

nodes.label: Book catalog menus
nodes.summary: Main menu dispatches add, list, search, analysis and exit; selected books expose edit/delete.

nodes.label: Book schema and session
nodes.summary: Book stores title, author, date and integer-cent price on a SQLite-backed session.

nodes.label: Suggested-books CSV
nodes.summary: Startup imports missing titles from a CSV; its record values are outside this map.

nodes.label: Local SQLite catalog
nodes.summary: Session queries and commits persist the catalog; actual database records are excluded.

nodes.label: Project reference and license
nodes.summary: Original course documentation and any upstream license remain separate from executable processing.
